origin_archive_member_base: Only legacy origin_archive_member fields refer to the campaign root in the original archive. New origin_addendum_member fields use the separate metrology addendum reference.

current_status.scope: 70 primary A, 68 primary conditional B plus two separate conditional B; no physical C qualification
current_status.payload: The documented 2.048-V/12-bit/20-mOhm/gain-25 design gives 1 mA per count. Raw ADC-code transmission is consistent with the nominal mA convention; it does not demonstrate a unit error. Installed component/range and calibration applicability remain separate bindings.
current_status.power_boundary: The master thesis studies the Jetson-slot path. Its supply voltage is not assumed to be 5 V. Later CH0 full-system-input calibration and U(I) applicability must follow their own profiles and wiring evidence.
current_status.filter: Approximately 77 kHz is a documented differential-RC design value before INA225, not its general component bandwidth or a newly measured complete-path transfer function.
current_status.historical_b500: Generic percentile functions were found; nine rows retain stored_bounds because original replicates and exact invocation/seed are unbound.
current_status.historical_versions: Current package/NPU firmware observations are not retroactively assigned; measurement-source firmware is a separate identity.
current_status.full_system_scale_factor_application: The setup-specific full-system factor s multiplies the completed power model. Historical Joris/Jetson power correction c remains a separate factor; neither denotes an additional ADC/current calibration. See each bound conversion path.
current_status.historical_calibration: 36 load points across 0..3.5 A and a separate verification are documented for the original work. This does not retroactively provide a before/after drift or validation record for each October setup.
current_status.U_I_mapping: The later setup-specific full-system input models and original Jetson-slot U(I) boundary are distinct; exact board/supply/wiring applicability remains partial.

minimum_remaining_evidence: Resolve ADS7953 versus ADS7952 using an existing unambiguous schematic/BOM or population record; retain the documented nominal design meanwhile.
Bind the populated board/revision, active ADC range/reference, actual firmware build and exact CH0 circuit without treating channel confirmation as missing.
Document the exact differential R/C topology and values and complete-path/timebase/alias limits; the 77-kHz design origin is already documented.
Bind each existing current/voltage model and full-system factor to its supply, wiring, consumers and operating range; do not transfer the original slot U(I) model blindly.
Retain the original separate verification while distinguishing missing October before/after drift, reference-instrument uncertainty and combined E/N uncertainty.
Any future proven conversion correction requires a new versioned analysis of unchanged raw data; this documentation alignment changes no conversion factors.
